# Marionette

Start here when using the installed package or this repository to build an application.

- [Quick start](docs/quick-start.md): templates, Regions, CollectionView, events, Behavior, Radio, Application, and v4 migration.
- [Interactive and bounded lists](docs/list-composition.md): managed rows, identity, selection, and large collections.
- [Task routing](docs/agents.md): choose the guide needed for the current task.
- [Compact contracts](docs/compact-reference.md): ownership, readiness, and teardown.
- [API index](docs/readme.md): individual reference pages.
- [Migration from v4](upgradeGuide.md).

Read the quick start first, then only the guide needed for your task. Search docs/*.md
for API guidance; test/, scripts/, and config/ contain supporting evidence and metadata.
The installed package version is in package.json. Its documentation provenance is
in docs-manifest.json. This file is a discovery index, not maintainer instructions.
